description.zh:
按任务ID查询预热任务详情。
支持单次查询一个任务ID。
description.en: Queries a preload task by task ID. You can query one task ID at a time.

descriptions.zh:
- 支持查询3天内（包含3天）的数据。
- 单用户调用频率为：30次/秒。
descriptions.en:
- You can query data within the last 3 days.

- Each account can call this operation up to 30 times per second.
